ck: (30)petacintaratnan visesanasitinasankya sanatate nanviti aparanartikapetankikaratityupalaksanan vastavatatatnyankikaratityapi trastavyan katatvaterityatipatena prtuputnotarakaratvaterkrahanan katapatayorEkye katasyEva patatvena katatvate patavrtitvan nastityarta uktaritya katatvate patatve patanistatyantapavapratiyokitvan vacyan yavatsvatikarananistatyantapavapratiyokitvarupanityatvankikarat evanca tanatranevastu hetuvisesananiti pavena pariharati — pate katatvaniti kataniti tasyEva nityasaptartatvankikarat tatra parasanatinaha — paresaniti pavanan svasrayatvena sanate vastunyevatikaranetyantapavan prati pratiyokitvan nrsatneti sanpanta syatetat yati katopatatvan pratyasraya syatata nityatvakatanaya tatatyantapavopi tatrankikarya syat na cEvan purvanasiticotanan tu patasya patatvavisesakatatvan pratyasrayatvapavepi katapatayostatatnyanasrityetyata aha — patasya katatvan pratiti suprasitanititi tatatyantapavasyEva tatanyasrayatvasaptartatvatiti pava yatuktan patatvavisesasrayatvan nastiti tana patasyEva svapavatvena tatvina patasya vastavavesantarapavat na hi cetanesviva catesu pakatyakenEkyanucyata iti
